cards.text: Paul is writing to the churches in Galatia (Galatians 1:2). He's been telling them how he got his gospel by revelation from Jesus Christ (Galatians 1:12), and how he himself used to persecute the church of God (Galatians 1:13). Now he jumps ahead fourteen years, and he's headed up to Jerusalem again.

cards.question: Paul doesn't make the Jerusalem trip alone. He goes up with Barnabas, and he takes ___ along too.

cards.text: Barnabas is Paul's ministry partner (Acts 13:2), and Titus is his partner and fellow worker (2 Corinthians 8:23). Paul doesn't just walk into Jerusalem, friend. He rolls in with BACKUP.
Paul says he went in response to a revelation. Then he sets the gospel he preaches among the Gentiles right out on the table, the WHOLE batch, nothing tucked under the counter.

cards.question: Paul sets before them the gospel he preaches among the Gentiles. Who does he say he spoke to privately?
Paul says he spoke privately to the leaders for fear that he was running, or had already run, in vain. What's he worried about?

answers.text: That his work was for nothing
That he was running out of time
That the crowd would chase him off

cards.text: Titus is right there with Paul, and he's a Greek. I bet he feels like the different one in the room, and friend, I pack cookie boxes with my MUSTACHE, so I get it.

cards.question: True or false: In Jerusalem, Titus the Greek is compelled to be circumcised.

cards.text: So where did that circumcision question even come from? Paul says it came up because some false brothers had come in under false pretenses, which is like me calling a burnt batch "extra crispy."

cards.question: Paul says some false brothers came in under false pretenses. What did they come in to do?

answers.text: Spy on their freedom in Christ
Bring a gift for the leaders

cards.question: Paul says the false brothers spied on their freedom in Christ Jesus in order to ___ them.
True or false: Paul and the others give in to the false brothers for a little while.

Paul and the others don't give in to the false brothers, not for a MOMENT. Me? Ask me twice for the last cookie and I fold like an empty cookie box. What does Paul say they held on for, so it would remain with the Galatians?

cards.text: Now the highly esteemed leaders in Jerusalem, big names, BIG reputations. Paul says whatever they were makes no difference to him, and friend, I get nervous when the oven TIMER looks at me.

cards.question: Why doesn't it make any difference to Paul who the highly esteemed leaders in Jerusalem were?

answers.text: He outranked every one of them
He had never met any of them

cards.question: True or false: Paul says the highly esteemed leaders in Jerusalem added nothing to him.

cards.text: Instead, they see that Paul has been entrusted to preach the gospel, just like Peter, one of Jesus' twelve apostles (Matthew 10:2). Paul getting put next to PETER? That's like somebody putting me next to that shiny new stamper, and friend, NOBODY does that.

cards.question: The leaders see that Paul was entrusted to preach the gospel to the ___, just as Peter was to the ___.
Peter's apostleship is to the circumcised, and Paul's is to the Gentiles. Who does Paul say was at work in his apostleship?

answers.text: The same One at work in Peter

cards.text: Now meet the three known as pillars: James, the Lord's brother (Galatians 1:19), Cephas, which is Peter (John 1:42), and John, another of the twelve apostles (Matthew 10:2). PILLARS, friend, and I'm standing on a gold base and STILL wobble when the oven door slams.

cards.question: True or false: James, Cephas and John recognize the grace that Paul had been given.
Recognizing the grace Paul had been given, what do James, Cephas and John give Paul and Barnabas?

answers.text: A letter for all the churches

cards.text: So the plan is set: Paul and Barnabas go to the Gentiles, and the pillars go to the circumcised. Same recipe, friend, just two delivery routes.
And the pillars only have ONE request. When I say "just one thing," friend, it's three things and a sticky note on the oven.

cards.question: James, Cephas and John make just one request of Paul and Barnabas. What is it?
True or false: Paul has to be talked into remembering the poor.

findings.problem: Stop 2, card 11 quotes "just one thing", which isn't the exact BSB wording.

rule.text: Quotes: Quotation marks around Bible words mean the exact BSB wording, punctuation included.

findings.problem: This non-opening story card has three sentences: the identifications of Barnabas and Titus, 'Paul doesn't just walk into Jerusalem, friend,' and 'He rolls in with BACKUP.' The limit is two sentences.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.
